tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the eSignStack guides and the API reference. Returns matching pages with a snippet; read one with read_doc.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one documentation page or API operation in full, by the slug that search_docs returned (for example "webhooks", "mcp" or "api:post /webhook_endpoints").

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "docs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_doc · Public sink: read_doc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_doc · Public sink: read_doc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
